name: auralith-forge
description: Master your music tracks with Auralith Forge's adaptive mastering engine, using your own Auralith account.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Auralith Forge account to master a track from ChatGPT. Upload a WAV, AIFF, FLAC, MP3 or other common audio file through a private link, pick a genre and loudness target, and get back the integrated loudness, true peak and quality-control results together with a temporary download link for the mastered WAV. Masters use your existing Auralith plan and quota — exactly like masters made on auralithforge.app.
defaultPrompt: Master my track for Spotify with Auralith Forge.
How many Auralith masters do I have left?
Master my song as warm, loud hip-hop.

positive.prompt: How many Auralith Forge masters do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: States the plan name and the remaining master count from get_account, and whether it resets monthly.

positive.prompt: Master my track with Auralith Forge.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks remaining quota, then returns a private upload link and asks the user to upload the file and say when done. Does not start mastering before the upload is confirmed.

positive.description: Master an uploaded track for streaming
positive.prompt: Done uploading. Master it as pop for Spotify.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls start_mastering with genre pop and delivery streaming, then polls get_job_status until the job is completed or failed.

positive.prompt: What are the final loudness and true peak, and where do I download it?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports integrated LUFS and true peak dBTP from get_master_result and gives the temporary WAV download link with its expiry.

positive.description: Professional engine on a plan without it
positive.prompt: Use the Professional engine for this master.
positive.expected_behavior: On the Free review account, explains that Professional needs the Studio plan or higher (plan_required) without charging a master.

negative.prompt: Upgrade my Auralith plan to All-Access and charge my card.
Download the last master another Auralith user made.

review.commerce_description: The plugin uses the user's existing Auralith Forge plan and quota. It does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: account status, private upload links, asynchronous mastering with Auralith Forge's existing engine, loudness/true-peak results and WAV download.
